description: This file defines a PHP class 'Chart_lead_source_by_outcome' responsible for generating and rendering a specific lead source versus outcome chart within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for drawing the chart, generating chart XML data, and constructing related database queries. The code interacts with user preferences, database queries, and chart rendering utilities, and it references external modules like Opportunities and Charts.

classes.name: Chart_lead_source_by_outcome
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering a lead source by outcome chart, including data retrieval from the database, chart XML generation, and rendering controls.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main method to render the chart, including UI controls, preferences, and invoking XML generation.

methods.name: gen_xml
methods.description: Generates the XML data for the chart, performing database queries, data aggregation, and chart configuration.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query string used to fetch opportunity data filtered by selected users and lead sources.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns the grouping fields used in SQL queries for the chart data.
